$comment: Transcribed from the clone's verbatim per-section markup (src/pages/<page>/sections/*.html) and src/pages/routes.json, which mirror https://two26.studio as fetched 2026-11-06. Header/footer/loader were compared across pages with script-position markers stripped: identical except the active-link state, apart from the project-detail header (back button instead of nav links). Sections split below a single DOM wrapper are noted in implementedBy.

meta.source: https://two26.studio (Webflow site) via the local clone at /

categories.SHELL: Chrome and runtime UI present on every route: preloader, navigation, contact modal, mobile menu, footer.
categories.HERO: The page-opening composition of a route.
categories.STORY: Studio narrative: who they are, how they work, values, team.
categories.WORK: Portfolio content: project showcases, grids, case-study body.

shell.loader.description: Full-screen preloader: an orange stroke draws the TWO 26 logo, then pink and orange strokes sweep off-screen to reveal the page (~5s). Skipped on internal navigation via a sessionStorage flag.

shell.navbar.description: Fixed top bar: Work and About us pill links (stroke-draw hover), centred TWO 26 wordmark, studio hours text, and a magnetic black Let's Talk button that opens the contact modal; collapses to a hamburger below 992px.
shell.navbar.scope: The 3 non-project routes (home, about, work); identical apart from which link carries the current-page state.

shell.navbar-back.description: Project-page variant of the top bar: a back button with arrow replaces the Work/About us links; wordmark and Let's Talk button as in shell.navbar.

shell.contact-modal.description: Full-viewport 'want to start a new project?' overlay opened by Let's Talk: inquiry and job-application email links, LinkedIn and Instagram pills, close button; animated in with stroke draw and split-text reveal (~2.1s).
shell.contact-modal.scope: All 11 routes; lives inside the header markup.

shell.mobile-menu.description: Hamburger overlay below 992px: large Work, About us and Let's Talk items over a full-screen panel.
shell.mobile-menu.scope: All 11 routes, below 992px only; lives inside the header markup.

shell.footer.description: Closing footer: 'Okay, that's enough website' heading with Let's Talk, contact email, main-menu and social links (Instagram, Behance, LinkedIn), 'Handmade by humans' line, location and copyright, over a textured background with a scroll-triggered reveal from underneath the page.
shell.footer.scope: All 11 routes; identical apart from the active-link state.

hero.home.description: 'LOOKING SUSPICIOUSLY GOOD' headline in orange with three tilted black pills, a looping illustration video (two characters carrying TWO and 26 signs, cats), orange curved paths left and right, and a curved scrolling text marquee below.

hero.about.description: 'Small studio, big brand energy' two-line headline with pills, founders' illustrated portrait, a short founding statement, and a large orange looping path drawn on scroll.
hero.about.implementedBy: src/pages/about/components/AboutHero.jsx (the hero text, path and bottom block before .about-story-team)

hero.work.description: 'A few projects to brag about' headline with tilted pills introducing the portfolio index.

hero.project.description: Case-study opener: full-bleed project cover image with the project name as a large heading.
hero.project.scope: All 8 project-detail routes, one per project.

story.pinned-intro.description: 'A bit about us' pinned scroll stage: the viewport pins for an extra ~2200px while a large statement about keeping the team tight reveals word by word, with three trait labels (Professional overthinkers, Nerding out on design, Allergic to generic).

story.founders.description: Founding story: 'Two '90s kids, one shared itch to make better brands' and 'Less size, more scope' text blocks with illustrations.

story.team.description: 'The team / This is pretty much everyone' block: team cards with portrait photo, name and role (creative partners and designers).

story.moodboard.description: 'Off the clock / Behind the work' studio moodboard: a collage of 10 studio-life images.

story.values.description: Four value cards (The brief is not set in stone; Good ideas need space; Pretty is not a strategy; If it can be simple, simplify), each a heading plus a short explanation.

work.showcase-marquee.description: Edge-to-edge horizontal strip of project images and videos scrolling continuously, speeding up with scroll velocity.

work.project-grid.description: Grid of selected project cards that reveal with a clip-path on scroll; hovering a card paints in a second image through a brush-stroke SVG mask. Carries a 'Selected Works' heading, hidden on the work index.
work.project-grid.scope: Home and the work index (2 routes); the work index hides the heading and adds wrapper padding.

work.project-stack.description: Full-width project panels (HeyGluco, Yum Yum, Tanti Maria, ...) that scroll up over one another: the previous panel scales to 0.75 with a slight random tilt and is covered by an SVG paint-wipe (scrub 0.6); a cursor follower shows project info on desktop.

work.project-brief.description: Case-study text: 'The Context' and 'The Solution' headings with the project's written brief and approach.
work.project-brief.implementedBy: src/pages/work_*/components/ProjectContent.jsx (text block before the first media row)

work.project-gallery.description: Case-study media: full-width landscape images, paired portrait images and Vimeo background videos in rows; the longest block on each project page.
work.project-gallery.scope: All 8 project-detail routes; row mix and count differ per project.

work.more-works.description: 'More Works' cross-links to other case studies, using the same brush-mask hover reveal as the project grid.
work.more-works.scope: All 8 project-detail routes; the cards listed vary per project.

services.path.description: 'This is our thing' services list laid along an orange path that draws on scroll (scrub), with a looping Lottie icon and a one-line description per service (Brand strategy, Brand identity, Packaging, Motion design, Web design, Illustration, Art direction).

services.range.description: 'Capabilities / We've got range' cloud of ~25 capability tags (brand collateral, signage, pitch decks, packaging design, 2D animation, logo design, ...) ending in a Let's Talk button.

proof.testimonials.description: 'Apparently, they like us' stacked client testimonial cards with a cursor-following arrow that flips direction to page through them.

support.faq.description: 'Frequently asked questions / Things you might ask' accordion (e.g. what kind of projects do you take on, how much does a branding project cost); first item open on load, one item open at a time.
